{{Dialogue|Whiplash|Hey! What outfit you from?|Fett|322nd.|Hotshot|I heard they had their tour.|Fett|They did. I&hellip;I couldn't make it. Broken arm.|attr=A group of clone cadets discuss the 322nd|src=<ref name="Death Trap">{{TCW|Death Trap}}</ref>}}
The '''322nd''' was a training group of [[Clone cadet/Legends|clone cadets]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. When [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] infiltrated the [[Clone Youth Brigade/Legends|Clone Youth Brigade]] using the alias "Lucky", he claimed to be from the 322nd. He was later questioned about this and claimed that, although the 322nd had already done their tour, he had missed it because of a broken arm.
